request.query: Bound absolute values of coefficients of a multivariate Hasse derivative by 2 to sum of variable degrees times a coefficient bound

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv
items.type:
(R : Type u_2) →
  {V : Type u_3} →
    [inst : AddCommGroup V] → [inst_1 : Semiring R] → [inst_2 : Module R V] → ℕ → LaurentSeries V →ₗ[R] LaurentSeries V

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_comp
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k l : ℕ),
  Polynomial.hasseDeriv k ∘ₗ Polynomial.hasseDeriv l = (k + l).choose k • Polynomial.hasseDeriv (k + l)

items.name: MvPolynomial.totalDegree_monomial_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : R),
  ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) c).totalDegree ≤ s.sum fun x => id

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] (k : ℕ)
  (f : LaurentSeries V) (n : ℤ), ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) f).coeff n = Ring.choose (n + ↑k) k • f.coeff (n + ↑k)

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - n

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_bdd_of_roots_le
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing F] [inst_1 : NormedField K] {B : ℝ} {d : ℕ} (f : F →+* K)
  {p : Polynomial F},
  p.Monic →
    (Polynomial.map f p).Splits →
      p.natDegree ≤ d →
        (∀ z ∈ (Polynomial.map f p).roots, ‖z‖ ≤ B) →
          ∀ (i : ℕ), ‖(Polynomial.map f p).coeff i‖ ≤ max B 1 ^ d * ↑(d.choose (d / 2))
